features.name: x001_centered_scale
features.description: Clipped z-score of x001 using training-fold mean and scale; preserves direction while limiting outlier leverage.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a smooth centered axis so a linear SVM can weight broad x001 changes without raw-unit dominance.

features.name: low_cardinality_code_density
features.description: Average of x002 through x010 after scaling each low-cardinality code to its training-fold range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Compresses several compact codes into one continuous load measure, giving the margin a robust first-order summary.

features.name: upper_status_activation_score
features.description: Mean activation of binary and ternary status fields x005, x006, x007, x008, and x015 after range scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a dense continuous summary from sparse small-range indicators, which is useful for a linear margin.

features.name: interaction_intensity_log_scale
features.description: Log-scaled x011 magnitude normalized by the training-fold upper range to reduce heavy-tail influence.
features.expected_model_benefit: Transforms a highly skewed magnitude into a smooth bounded signal that a linear SVM can weight directly.

features.name: repeat_count_log_scale
features.description: Log-scaled x012 count normalized by the training-fold upper range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth diminishing-return representation of repeated activity for a linear margin.

features.name: intensity_per_repeat_ratio
features.description: Ratio of log-scaled x011 magnitude to log-scaled x012 count, clipped for robustness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a concentrated-versus-spread activity contrast in a single continuous dimension.

features.name: prior_recency_signal
features.description: Recency score from x013 with values at or above 990 treated as a placeholder state; smaller non-placeholder x013 gives higher score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Converts a sentinel-heavy column into a monotone bounded signal suitable for a linear margin.

features.name: prior_history_depth
features.description: Weighted depth of prior activity from x014 count and x015 code after range scaling.
features.expected_model_benefit: Combines two small-range history fields into a stable continuous severity measure.

features.name: macro_easing_projection
features.description: Weighted normalized projection over x016 through x020, higher for lower rate-like readings, softer price and employment-like readings, and stronger confidence-like readings.
features.expected_model_benefit: Supplies one interpretable linear macro axis from several correlated continuous columns.

features.name: rate_employment_gap_projection
features.description: Difference between standardized x019 and x020 to capture rate-like pressure relative to employment-like level.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a contrast axis that can expose departures from the usual joint movement of two correlated macro fields.

features.name: engagement_history_semantic_score
features.description: Numeric 0.0-1.0 assessment, using x011, x012, x013, x014, x015 and the fixed training-fold ranges, of whether the engagement and history pattern is coherent and strong: higher for sustained interaction, manageable repeat count, recent non-placeholder history, and meaningful prior activity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a compact expert-style ordering of several history fields that may be only partly captured by simple ratios, aiding a linear margin.

features.name: economic_regime_semantic_score
features.description: Numeric 0.0-1.0 assessment, using x016 through x020 and fixed training-fold ranges, of whether the economic context is internally coherent and supportive: higher for low rate-like pressure, stable confidence-like readings, and non-extreme employment-like levels.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a semantic macro summary that can reduce burden on the margin when combining several correlated economic columns.
